text: ROBI’s operation from 2026-05-15 to 2026-05-21 fulfilled 58 orders with a total of 163 orders processed, averaging 98 seconds per order. The most frequent failure was ‘unknown’ (57 times), impacting orders [cite:2] and [cite:3], alongside ‘search_exhausted’ (26 times) affecting [cite:4] and [cite:5]. There were 37 orders with warnings and the slowest order, #2 (water bottle, 817s), demonstrates a need to investigate potential issues with the [[gripper]] or [[sam3]] during [[search-sweep]] operations. **Focus monitoring efforts on order [cite:2] and [cite:3] to assess the root cause of the ‘unknown’ failures, potentially involving a [[scene-scan]] to verify object [[detection]] and [[reachability]].**
